plugins.name: pp-zcode
plugins.description: Pocock × PStack in one plugin: Matt Pocock's requirements skills ship bundled, implement-spec bridges a spec or ticket set to the poteto-mode execution engine (a zcode port of pstack), poteto-mode's independent review runs the bundled two-axis code-review, pipeline-accept gates delivery on evidence plus a code → spec sweep, and interrogate runs a multi-model adversarial review panel. Model roles are configured per host in ~/.zcode/pp-zcode/models.md. Invoke every skill by its qualified pp-zcode:<name> so a user-level install of the same skill cannot shadow it.

description_i18n.zh-CN: Pocock 需求技能随插件打包，implement-spec 把 spec/工单交接给 poteto-mode 执行引擎（pstack 移植版），执行侧独立评审走打包的双轴 code-review，pipeline-accept 凭证据验收并做 code → spec 补扫，interrogate 提供多模型对抗评审；各席位模型经 ~/.zcode/pp-zcode/models.md 配置；所有技能以 pp-zcode:<name> 限定名调用，避免被用户级同名技能遮蔽
